title: [IMP-06] Set up retained submission evidence
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-06

Source plan

Task ID
IMP-06

Title
Set up retained submission evidence

Category
Fields and forms

Objective
Keep every submitted or retained file and answer separate from later working corrections.

Detailed scope
Add PPAP Evidence Snapshot and PPAP Evidence Answer fields and historical views, including source lineage and write-once approval/rejection facts. The submission and retention assignments perform copying; this assignment provides the fields and protected ordinary controls.

Deliverable
Evidence record forms that show saved submission content and lineage without editable file/answer replacements.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-05 — Set up element work and checklist answers
IMP-07 — Set up the governed requirement library

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-05 provides the element/working-answer fields and typed preparation controls.
• IMP-07 provides the requirement/question authoring and version fields/forms.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: local evidence fields and historical layouts can proceed; external actor/visibility and native file protection remain supplied inputs.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Element
Create a link to PPAP Element, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Element.Evidence Snapshots. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Sequence
Set the type to a whole number (Integer/Int32). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Next integer within Element under lock. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain allocates with unique Element+Sequence; retry key action correlation, not double-click count.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Submission Comment
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: PPAP Element.Submission Comment on Submit. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; assignee may see own active submission; rejected snapshots internal history. Field/control lifecycle: Submit copies once; no direct edits.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Files
Use the Intelex native attachment collection, retaining file identity, name, length and content type. Do not create a custom file table. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: System writes at Submit/Retain; read only download subject to saved copy audience. Field/control lifecycle: Copy original bytes and native file metadata; validate copy completeness before workflow transition; approved/rejected history retained; no automatic deletion.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Reused From
Create a link to PPAP Evidence Snapshot, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; internal lineage navigation only. Field/control lifecycle: Retain stores immediate source; fresh submission NULL. Never grant receiving supplier access to source PPAP through lineage.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Compatibility Confirmation
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer via Retain Evidence; required when Reused From populated; otherwise NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Explicit confirmation of revision and selected-part compatibility; records source/receiving frozen contexts; same facility/drawing/element validated.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Nonlatest Selection Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer via Retain Evidence; required if selected source differs from latest eligible approved saved copy; otherwise NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Store decision at selection; suggested latest determined by Approved At then fixed identity as tie breaker.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Submitted At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Submit or Retain records actual action time once; native history retains action correlation.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Submitted By
Create a link to Employee, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain writes actual actor identity; external identity binding must be verified.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Approved At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Approve Element or Retain Evidence records approval once; absent until approved; never clear when element correction reopens.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Approved By
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: SIA PPAP Engineer approval or explicit retention actor stamps once; SIA PPAP Engineer can approve own internal work.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Rejected At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Return Element records rejection once on current saved copy; rejected saved copy never becomes reusable.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Review Feedback
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; assignee sees current return feedback, prior rejected saved copy remains internal. Field/control lifecycle: Return copies nonblank Element.Review Feedback; approved saved copy cannot later become rejected.

PPAP Evidence Answer.Evidence Snapshot
Create a link to PPAP Evidence Snapshot, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Answers. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Evidence Answer.Question Version
Create a link to PPAP Question Version, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain copies exact question version; unique Evidence Snapshot+Question Version.

PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Text
Set the type to Text; up to 8000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Submit: PPAP Answer.Answer - Text; Retain: selected source PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Text, or reconciled receiving PPAP Answer.Answer - Text. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=TEXT; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain Action Handler copies named source value; fixed, other typed values NULL. Preserve original source question version; receiving required answers must also be satisfied, never coerce changed answer types.

PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Number
Set the type to a finite number allowing decimals (Float); no silent rounding. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Submit: PPAP Answer.Answer - Number; Retain: selected source PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Number, or reconciled receiving PPAP Answer.Answer - Number. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=NUMBER; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain Action Handler copies named source value; fixed, other typed values NULL. Preserve original source question version; receiving required answers must also be satisfied, never coerce changed answer types.

PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Yes or No
Set the type to Nullable Boolean; NULL is unanswered. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Submit: PPAP Answer.Answer - Yes or No; Retain: selected source PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Yes or No, or reconciled receiving PPAP Answer.Answer - Yes or No. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=BOOLEAN; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain Action Handler copies named source value; fixed, other typed values NULL. Preserve original source question version; receiving required answers must also be satisfied, never coerce changed answer types.

PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Date
Set the type to Date; no time component. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Submit: PPAP Answer.Answer - Date; Retain: selected source PPAP Evidence Answer.Answer - Date, or reconciled receiving PPAP Answer.Answer - Date. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=DATE; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/Retain Action Handler copies named source value; fixed, other typed values NULL. Preserve original source question version; receiving required answers must also be satisfied, never coerce changed answer types.

PPAP Element.Evidence Snapshots
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Element; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Evidence Snapshot.Answers
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Evidence Answer.Evidence Snapshot; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Show saved evidence separately from Working Files and current editable answers. Preserve Sequence, source lineage and source Question Version; do not replace a submitted answer with the current working answer.
2. Allow only the named Submit/Retain/Approve/Return actions to write their listed fields. After submission content is saved, prohibit direct content edits; review actions may stamp their own decision fields once. An approved snapshot cannot later be relabeled rejected.
3. Keep old rejected evidence in internal history and show current supplier-safe feedback through the element work area. Selecting lineage never grants access to the source PPAP.

How to check the result
• Changing a working answer or file does not alter a previously saved submission.
• Approval and rejection facts identify their actual actors/times and cannot both be applied to the same saved submission.

Information needed for this task
IN-06: Supply supplier actor and historical-record visibility bindings for Submitted By and rejected/internal evidence.
IN-13: Supply the supported native file protection settings; field/form creation can proceed but final protection cannot be completed without them.

Supplied input context
• IN-06 — Record visibility, file access and supplier actor connection: The security/technical team must supply visibility classification values and access rules, native record/file/API/export enforcement methods, authorized handover principals, and the supported external-supplier-user to native actor/recipient identity connection. This information limits the affected security, posting, confirmation and recorded-actor settings.
• IN-13 — Supported attachment limits and file controls: The tenant administrator must supply supported file sizes/types and the native method that protects posted/submitted files from editing or deletion. Average files are 1 MB, not an upload maximum. Ordinary attachments need no specialist viewer.
